prompt: 9:16 portrait photograph, wide and lonely. Much later: a row of rusting metal starting stalls stands on overgrown wet turf, every front gate long since open. From the right-hand box a lone horse trots out towards the camera, unhurried, a few wisps of hay still in its mouth, its faded saddlecloth reading WAGES in plain capitals, the only readable word. A small rider sits slumped on its back, hood up against the rain. Ahead of it the course stretches away empty between white rails; the grandstand on one side is deserted, rows of bare wet seats. Steady rain, puddles, a heavy grey sky. Muted colours, real-looking photograph, melancholy and funny. Thanks.
